item.title: A year after Charlie Kirk's death, young conservatives face a divided movement
item.description: Charlie Kirk's death was seen as a rallying call for young conservatives. One year later, the movement is wrestling with questions about its future.

item.title: Miami Amazon cargo plane pilot warned of excessive speed before crash
item.description: For nearly two minutes, a pilot of the Amazon cargo plane that veered off a Miami runway repeatedly warned the other pilot they were approaching too fast.

item.title: What to expect Thursday after Trump's $5,000 payment pledge
item.description: President Trump pledged to send every adult citizen $5,000, contingent on Republicans keeping control of Congress in the midterm election.
